|notes = After arriving at [[Meiyerditch]], walk up the wall until you pass a section where the boards creak (you are informed in the chat pane). Kick the boards, and then climb down into the passage below. Dig west of the wall rubble. If you already completed [[Darkness of Hallowvale]], then right-click on the boards for the option to climb down.
The Armadylean guard fails to spawn and you have to dig at the clue until it spawns the Bandosian guard, which might take several attempts.
|level=4}}

|notes = Small island located north-east of [[Mos Le'Harmless]], accessible through the '''western''' staircase located at the north-east corner of the [[Mos Le'Harmless Cave]]. Remember to wear a [[Witchwood icon]] when traversing the dungeon, as well as bringing a [[light source]] for players who haven't lit the fire pit (requires completion of [[Making Friends with My Arm]]). It is possible that an [[Armadylean guard]] may appear, which means you may have to bring [[Ranged equipment]].

A [[Stepping Stone (Mos Le'Harmless, level 82)|level 82 Agility shortcut]] provides fast access from just north of the [[Trouble Brewing]] minigame entrance and eliminates the need to bring a Witchwood icon and light source.
